en.title: Inkling 2 Small
en.summary: Inkling 2 Small is a model that can see and refine what it builds. A discussion link is available for more details.
en.impact: This model may offer developers new capabilities for automated visual feedback and refinement in projects.
keyPoints: Inkling 2 Small can see and refine what it builds
